testCase.name: AGP Version Conflict
testCase.description: Invalid AGP version 8.10.0 doesn't exist in Maven Central

metadata.context: AGP version 8.10.0 not found in Maven Central

agent_response.rootCause: The error occurs because the AGP version specified in the gradle/libs.versions.toml file is incompatible with Gradle's current version (8.9). The correct AGP version should be 8.10.0 or higher to work seamlessly with Gradle 8.9.
fixGuidelines: Replace the AGP version in gradle/libs.versions.toml at line 2 from '8.1.0' to '8.10.0'
Verify the fix by rebuilding the project using ./gradlew clean build
